name: Hover Rally
author: Retro Console
description: Eight hover-craft, three laps, three tracks. Ride sweeping curves, hills and banked turns, boost with your shield energy and recharge on the glowing strips. Finish in the top four to unlock the next track.

achievements.name: Podium Finish
achievements.desc: Finish a race in the top three

achievements.name: Fuel Up
achievements.desc: Recharge 150 energy from strips in one run
